listing.title: Universal PDF: Editor & Signer
listing.shortDescription: Scan, fill in and sign PDFs. No account, nothing uploaded, free.
fullDescription: Most PDF apps want an account, a subscription and a copy of your documents. Universal PDF asks for none of them.

There is no account to make. Nothing is uploaded: every page is opened, filled in, signed and blacked out on your phone, and it all works with no connection. It is free, with nothing to buy, and its code is public for anyone to check.
WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH IT
Scan a letter, a form or a receipt with the camera. It becomes a PDF, and its text can be made searchable.
Fill in a form by typing straight into its boxes.
Sign with your finger. Draw it once and keep it for next time.
Black out names and numbers for good. The words are removed from the file, not hidden under a box someone can lift off.
Send to sign: add "Sign here" boxes and share the PDF. The other person signs in whatever PDF app they have.
Make it smaller for email, lock it with a password, merge several into one, move or remove pages, turn photos into a PDF, or compare two versions.
Hold the app's icon for Scan. Open a PDF or a picture from any app's share sheet. What you have worked on waits on the desk, on this phone only.
Universal PDF is licensed AGPL-3.0. The code, and a plain account of what leaves your phone and when, are at github.com/universal-simulation-ltd/Universal_PDF
Made by James Markey MBE with the UNI·SIM team.
